author: Durk
install_msg: Thank you for installing the MessageFilter cog, loser!
name: MessageFilter
short: Delete messages that don't contain required words
description: Automatically delete messages that don't contain one of a channel's required words. Supports wildcards, per-channel stats, timeouts on violations, and logging. Sentiment filtering now lives in the SentimentFilter cog.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store user data.
